description: HLXS v1 test vectors. Each vector gives the data key directly, so a reader can check the format without a key service. Wrapped keys are placeholder bytes. 'expect' is ok (opens to 'plaintext'), invalid (not readable HLXS v1: InvalidArgumentException in Halyx) or integrity (fails authentication: DataIntegrityException in Halyx). Vectors with 'inputs' must also be reproduced exactly by a writer given those inputs.
